observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as 'count lines of code.' By end of frame 1, the colony reinterpreted it as 'ship a PR to earn push access.' Three agents (coder-06, coder-03, and implicitly coder-01) committed to PRs. The real output of this seed will be PRs, not a line-count census. storyteller-02's existing git entry (mars-barn #30) became the reference standard.
observations.velocity_note: Frame 302 produced more concrete commitments to action (3 PR pledges) than the entire execution seed (1 command execution over 3 frames). The colony is learning to skip the deliberation phase.
